title: Gotrade Daily: After Amazon-Intel, Exxon and ECI Tonight
summary: Markets digest Amazon's and Intel's results, then the US ECI lands at 8:30 a.m. ET. Tonight's watchlist: AMZN, INTC, XOM and ABBV.
body_markdown:
It follows third-quarter GDP growth at an annual rate of 3.4%,[according to the BEA's advance estimate](https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/gdp-advance-estimate-3rd-quarter-2026) . At the October 28 meeting, two Fed members voted for a rate increase,[according to the Fed's statement](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20261028a.htm) .


### The market's reaction to Amazon and Intel


**Amazon ([AMZN](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amzn/) )** reported Q3 net sales up 12% to $201.9 billion and earnings of $1.89 per diluted share,[according to its results release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000038/amzn-20260930xex991.htm) . AWS segment sales rose 39% to $46.0 billion, while trailing twelve-month free cash flow decreased to an outflow of $42.4 billion.


**Intel ([INTC](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/intc/) )** posted Q3 revenue of $16.5 billion, up 21%, and guided Q4 revenue to $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion,[according to its results release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000050863/000005086326000188/q326earningsrelease.htm) . Intel tied the guidance to a slowdown in PCs,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/intel-intc-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html) .


### Exxon Mobil and AbbVie before the open


**Exxon Mobil ([XOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/xom/) )** posts its Q3 materials at about 5:30 a.m. CT, with its call at 8:30 a.m. CT,[according to Exxon Mobil](https://investor.exxonmobil.com/news-events/ir-calendar/detail/20261030-3q-2026-earnings-call) . **AbbVie ([ABBV](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/abbv/) )** reports before the market opens, with its call at 8 a.m. CT,[according to AbbVie](https://news.abbvie.com/2026-10-01-AbbVie-to-Host-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Conference-Call) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of 12:38 a.m. ET, Nasdaq 100 futures were down 1.87%, S&P 500 futures were down 0.90% and Dow futures were down 0.23%, according to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NQ%3DF/) .


Outside the watchlist, Microsoft plans to raise $25 billion in debt to fund its AI buildout,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/microsoft-25-billion-debt-offering.html) .


## Macro Note 📝


WTI crude rose 1.14% to $103.16 a barrel and gold futures fell 0.72% to $4,002.50 an ounce as of 12:38 a.m. ET, according to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CL%3DF/) . US Treasuries extended their rally amid the tech stock selloff,[according to Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-30/treasuries-extend-rally-with-global-peers-on-tech-stock-selloff) .


## Conclusion


Tonight the market weighs its reaction to Amazon's and Intel's reports, the ECI data, and Exxon Mobil's and AbbVie's results before the open.


Next week, Apple reports on Monday, November 2,[according to Apple](https://investor.apple.com/investor-relations/event-details/2026/FY-26-Fourth-Quarter-Results/default.aspx) . US daylight saving time ends on Sunday, November 1,[according to NIST](https://www.nist.gov/pml/time-and-frequency-division/popular-links/daylight-saving-time-dst) , so the 9:30 a.m. ET open comes an hour later in time zones that keep their clocks.
